import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 998244353;
    static final long MODD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_LEN = 1000005;
    
    static long[] pow10 = new long[15];
    static List<String>[] candidates = new List[7];
    static List<Integer>[][] processed = new List[7][7];
    static long[][] prefix_sum = new long[7][7];
    
    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        String first;
        int second;
        
        Pair(String first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
        
        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair other) {
            return this.first.compareTo(other.first);
        }
    }
    
    static long str_to_ll(String s) {
        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            res = res * 10 + (s.charAt(i) - '0');
        }
        return res;
    }
    
    static long compute(String prefix, int remaining, long[] counter) {
        if (remaining == -1) return 0;
        int left_len = remaining / 2;
        int right_len = remaining - left_len;
        if (remaining == 1) {
            left_len = 1;
            right_len = 0;
        }
        
        long result = (int)((counter[0] - str_to_ll(prefix) + MOD * MOD) % MOD);
        counter[0]++;
        
        for (String left_part : candidates[left_len]) {
            String combined = prefix + left_part;
            result = (int)((result + (-str_to_ll(combined) + counter[0] + MOD * MOD) % MOD) % MOD);
            counter[0]++;
            
            if (left_part.length() == left_len) {
                long val = str_to_ll(combined) % MOD;
                for (int right_size = 1; right_size <= right_len; ++right_size) {
                    long constant = (int)((-val * pow10[right_size] + counter[0] + MOD * MOD) % MOD);
                    List<Integer> vec = processed[right_len][right_size];
                    int idx = Collections.binarySearch(vec, (int)(MOD - constant));
                    if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;
                    result = (int)((result + (long)vec.size() * constant + prefix_sum[right_len][right_size] - (long)MOD * (vec.size() - idx)) % MOD);
                }
                counter[0] += candidates[right_len].size();
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        int total_digits = String.valueOf(n).length();
        
        pow10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 14; ++i) pow10[i] = pow10[i-1] * 10;
        
        String s = String.valueOf(n);
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; ++i) {
            candidates[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j <= 6; ++j) {
                processed[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_LEN; ++i) {
            String num_str = String.valueOf(i);
            String padded = num_str;
            while (padded.length() <= 6) {
                padded = "0" + padded;
                candidates[padded.length()].add(padded);
            }
        }
        
        for (int len = 1; len <= 6; ++len) {
            for (String prev : candidates[len-1]) {
                candidates[len].add(prev);
            }
            Collections.sort(candidates[len]);
            
            for (int j = 0; j < candidates[len].size(); ++j) {
                int val = (int)((j - Integer.parseInt(candidates[len].get(j)) + MOD) % MOD);
                processed[len][candidates[len].get(j).length()].add(val);
            }
            
            for (int sz = 1; sz <= len; ++sz) {
                Collections.sort(processed[len][sz]);
                for (int v : processed[len][sz]) {
                    prefix_sum[len][sz] = (prefix_sum[len][sz] + v) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        
        List<Pair> queries = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder current = new StringBuilder();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); ++i) {
            for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
                if (digit == s.charAt(i) - '0') continue;
                if (i == 0 && digit == 0) continue;
                
                current.append((char)('0' + digit));
                if (digit <= s.charAt(i) - '0') {
                    queries.add(new Pair(current.toString(), s.length() - i - 1));
                } else {
                    queries.add(new Pair(current.toString(), s.length() - i - 2));
                }
                current.deleteCharAt(current.length() - 1);
            }
            current.append(s.charAt(i));
            queries.add(new Pair(current.toString(), 0));
        }
        
        long[] counter = {1};
        long answer = 0;
        Collections.sort(queries);
        
        for (Pair q : queries) {
            if (s.charAt(q.first.length() - 1) == q.first.charAt(q.first.length() - 1)) {
                answer = (answer + (-str_to_ll(q.first) + counter[0] + MOD * MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
                counter[0]++;
                continue;
            }
            answer = (answer + compute(q.first, q.second, counter)) % MOD;
        }
        
        answer %= MODD;
        pw.println(answer);
        pw.close();
    }
}
